verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart: the three steps are scattered around the canvas in tiny, unreadable type (01 at the top, 02 and 03 near the bottom, out of reading order), the logo has shrunk to a speck in the footer, and the oversized bag pushes the headline into a cramped right column. B keeps the original's structure and readability, but it is basically the original copied onto a square canvas. Its left edges don't line up (logo/headline, the 01–03 numerals, CTA and footer all start at different x positions), and the bag sits small inside the circle, leaving weak balance and dead space at the bottom.
